layout.arrangement: Figure-only slide. Outer red-bordered light-gray canvas; white matplotlib plot left-center; yellow badge '47' top-right; bottom black player bar. Plot shows a filled contour decision surface (blue left, red right, speckled gray band) with blue/red scatter along a spiral and a short black arrow near the center pointing right.

regions.name: plot
regions.content: Axes box with contour fill, scatter, arrow

visual_elements.description: Outer red frame stroke ~2-3px #B00000; inner gray field #DCDCDC
Axes frame, white field, black spines/ticks/labels; x ticks 0,5,...,35; y ticks -10,0,...,40

Filled contour decision surface across axes: blue #1F4FD8 left/top-left, red #E02424 right/top-right, gray #C4C4C4 band densely dithered with #0A0A0A dots; nested inner rings alternate red/blue around a small white wedge near [0.490,0.545,0.515,0.575]
Scatter, two unlabeled color classes along the spiral: blue #1F4FD8 dots and red #E02424 dots
Short black arrow near spiral center, direction left-to-right (increasing x), data approx (16,11) to (21.5,11)

typography_notes: No title. Tick numerals sans-serif (DejaVu-like), ~10-11 pt regular black; x centered under ticks, y right-aligned. Badge '47' medium/bold sans ~18 pt black centered.
recreation_brief: 1. White canvas; red border rectangle stroke #B00000 at [0.016,0.046,0.984,0.951]; fill inside with #DCDCDC. 2. White axes rectangle [0.231,0.124,0.777,0.874], black spines/ticks; y ticks top-to-bottom 40,30,20,10,0,-10; x ticks left-to-right 0..35 step 5 (~11 pt black). 3. Render filled contour surface: blue #1F4FD8 left/top-left, red #E02424 right/top-right, gray #C4C4C4 band dithered with #0A0A0A dots; nested inner rings alternating red/blue around small white wedge near plot center. 4. Scatter two unlabeled classes: blue #1F4FD8 and red #E02424 dots along the spiral. 5. Short black arrow near data (17-21, 11) pointing right. 6. Pale-yellow ellipse badge [0.925,0.072,0.982,0.170] (fill #F2F0A6, outline #5A5A5A), centered black '47' ~18 pt. 7. Full-width black bar [0.000,0.965,1.000,1.000].
